title: A Letter From Kaylie
text: A LETTER FROM KAYLIE Dear reader, I am utterly enchanted that you picked up Phantasma and joined me, Ophelia, and Blackwell on this romantic, Gothic adventure. If you enjoyed Phantasma and would like to keep up to date with all my latest releases, you can sign up at the following link! Your email address will never be shared and you can unsubscribe at any time. Sign up here! Of all the books I’ve had the pleasure of writing, Phantasma may have the largest piece of my heart thus far. It contains all of my favorite things: hot ghosts, Gothic ballgowns, blood, nods to my hometown’s lush foliage and food, girls with complicated feelings about family, and, most of all, a haunting romance. My experience living with OCD is so deeply ingrained in Ophelia’s character that writing her has brought healing in a way that writing no other character ever has for me before. In all my previous novels I’ve written my characters from my scars—not my open wounds—but Ophelia’s tale, and Blackwell’s enamored affection for her, was as cathartic for me as it was exciting. My hope is that you had just as much fun watching them fall in love as I did writing it—and will return to join me for more deliciously haunting adventures in this world. If you did enjoy Phantasma, I would be unendingly grateful if you could leave this book a review. Readers are truly the soul of the book world, and I am always so grateful to each and every one of you who takes the time to share your thoughts about my books so others may discover my stories. Your support is the reason I get to continue this dream, and for that, you will always have my heart. Starry wishes, Kaylie Smith www.kayliesmithbooks.com
